name: Signal Seeker
description: Signal Seeker: a cozy night shift at Relay Station Kettle-7. Tune the live spectrogram, catch drifting signals, flip the noisy bits clean, deliver the letters of eight recurring callers, collect the fragments of a lost civilization, and spend your tokens on the station. PIXEL the cat helps, in her way. Type PLAY, or SIGSEEK (SIGSEEK /52 or /ADM for a VT52 or an ADM-3A).
credit: Costin Stroie; MIT licence. Source in apps/sigseek; the program is its v1.51.1 release.
